intro: > One row per algorithm document in this directory. Keep sorted by slug.
> Update the row in the **same change** that changes the document (G8/G9).

rows.name: Deterministic Document Pipeline (canonical store → pure render → integrity verify)
rows.summary: Store-as-truth + pure renderer + sha256 integrity check: the three pipeline docs become a function of canonical-JSON data; out-of-band edits are diagnosed, not just detected (B10)

rows.name: Lessons Record (append-only entry log with a derived self-describing TSV index)
rows.summary: Append-only `LLT-NNNN` lesson log with closed vocabularies, bidirectional supersession, derived index, and the 0/1/2 exit model

rows.name: Line-Index Sync (marker scan, delta computation, idempotent TSV rewrite)
rows.summary: Self-describing TSV index blocks: one constant delta puts every reported line number in post-rewrite coordinates; `sync` idempotent, `check` detects drift (exit 1)

rows.name: RMF Evidence Bundle (deterministic collection, control mapping, rendering, packaging)
rows.summary: Fixed 11-control catalog + explicit evidence corpus → deterministic SSP/SAP/SAR/POA&M bundles + canonical manifest from repo state (zero network, byte-identical reruns); pinned CLI/Makefile contract

rows.name: Workflow-YAML Strict Parse (duplicate mapping-key detection for CI workflows)
rows.summary: One-pass `StrictLoader` hard-fails duplicate mapping keys (block + flow, any depth) with 1-based line of the second occurrence; 0/1/2 exit contract — closes the local-vs-GitHub parser tolerance gap (LLT-0017/LLT-0018)

rules: Add a row when a document is created; never delete a row (mark `deprecated` instead).
The `File` link is the canonical location — no copies elsewhere in the repo.
`Version` must equal the document's `METADATA` version (CI can assert this).
Backfilled rows keep `Status: backfilled` permanently as a provenance marker; behavioral changes do not remove it.
CI check: every `algorithms/*.md` (except `INDEX.md`) has exactly one row, and every row points at an existing file.
